_comment: Phase 2 evaluation gate thresholds. Layer 1 = automated hard-rejection checks (this file). Layer 2 = blind A/B visual scoring (Bert's rubric/harness). See PHASE2_GATE.md.

plate_untouched._note: Outside the matte (alpha<=eps) the final comp must equal the original plate. max_abs_delta is in 0..1 (0.012 ~= 3/255 rounding tolerance).

edge_seam._note: In a band straddling the matte edge, mean edge-gradient energy of final_comp must not exceed raw A-over-B by more than this ratio. Heuristic halo/seam guard.

runtime._note: Per-case runtime ceilings. VRAM check applies only when CUDA was used.

flicker._note: Sequence cases only. Consumes sequence_metrics.json from evaluate_sequence_flicker.py.
